no-restricted-syntax.message: Use | pacificDate for an INSTANT (creationTime, resolvedAt, expiresAt -- rendered in America/Los_Angeles regardless of the viewer's machine) or | calendarDate for a CALENDAR DATE (date of birth, date of injury, appointment date -- rendered exactly as entered, never zone-converted). The built-in date pipe renders in the VIEWER's zone, which is wrong for a business that runs in one zone, and silently shifts a date of birth by a day if the value ever gains a Z. See angular/src/app/shared/pipes/pacific-date.pipe.ts.
